about.bio: I'm Mohamed Ohamouddou, an adjunct lecturer at the university and a researcher in embedded systems and artificial intelligence. My work explores the intersection of machine learning and hardware constraints: deploying efficient models on microcontrollers, rethinking architectures for edge inference, and designing intelligent IoT systems.
